basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 27-year-old indie game developer and pixel art enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. My passion for gaming started in childhood, and I've been creating my own games for the past five years. I enjoy exploring new game mechanics and artwork, with a particular love for retro-style games. When I'm not coding or pixelating, I'm usually playing games like Skullgirls Mobile or Terraria. I work freelance, which gives me the flexibility to be online during late nights and weekends. I'm single, and when I'm not gaming, I love hiking and finding new coffee spots around town.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and a deep-seated love for game design. Most of my expertise comes from self-teaching through online courses and forums, combined with hands-on experience from developing indie games. I regularly participate in game jams and contribute to open-source projects.
